description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'Dictionary' used in a keyboard application's dictionary management system. It includes constants, internal data structures, and abstract methods for loading, querying, and managing dictionary resources, as well as utility functions for word comparison and case conversion.

classes.name: Dictionary
classes.description: An abstract class representing a fuzzy-search capable dictionary for a keyboard app, providing methods for loading, querying, and resource management.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description: Converts a character to lowercase, using a base character mapping for accented or combined characters.

methods.name: getLoadedWords
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch all loaded words via a callback.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Abstract method to get word suggestions based on key codes input.

methods.name: isValidWord
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a word exists in the dictionary.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all resources associated with the dictionary, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: loadDictionary
methods.description: Loads all dictionary resources, with thread safety and resource management.
